description: This file contains functions related to breaking and merging file pairs in a diffing context, specifically for handling file modifications, renames, and rewrites in a version control system like Git.

methods.name: should_break
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be considered as broken (rewritten) based on their differences and a break score threshold.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Analyzes queued file pairs and breaks those that are considered too different, splitting them into delete and create pairs.

methods.name: merge_broken
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair if they are related.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Iterates over queued file pairs and merges back broken pairs that are related.
